obligation.exact_statement: C2: Under current D1-D2,D6 prove the exact full C2 common-channel lower: for each legal N,k>=1, public u0=k/N, Delta=1/640000, c=Delta^2/8, one globally per-input/per-seed hard-k randomized batch T_(N,k), independent of Q/predictor/actual source label, makes conditional-terminal00 full-Z TV<=1/64 and for every common randomized full-Z predictor yields one SAME t_* with R00>=c and R_av>=ck/N. Prove stationary reversal and common atom directly, all intermediate pairs/adaptive commitments/truncated final block/97-episode/full symbol map; unnormalized Jordan cycle removal/path collapse, same input-row common-mass cancellation and bad fraction identity, finite rational seed and global legality; actual-terminal same-witness testing. Preserve unrestricted full-Z strong baseline, no old FULL19/011 premise.

assumptions: D1-D2 fix the true stationary D1 source, actual terminal query and one common randomized batch hard-edit observation channel before every encoder.
All algorithms see only Z,N,k,Q. Last pair is preserved on every input/seed; clean prefix, gap, endpoints, counts and private channel randomness are unavailable.

The upper is one unknown-parameter family for all sources/channels. The lower fixes one Q/predictor/source-label-independent channel before every full-Z predictor, then selects one source witness for both risks.
D3-D5 fix exact finite outputs and separate complete DIRECT bit-register and JOINT principal batch-hybrid cost vectors; no old Bstar or architecture superiority is claimed.

Old native Facts, file reviews and primary sources copied into inputs are provenance, not current-project admissions. All load-bearing clean/statistical/finite premises need valid new-project support.

quantifiers.domain: one D3 deterministic family, two D4 implementations, depends only on Z and public N,k,Q
all D1 parameters, all D2 public tuples and all admissible source-independent randomized batch channels
one globally per-input/per-seed hard-k T_(N,k), independent of actual source label, Q and predictor
every public Q and every common randomized full-Z predictor, unlimited computation/unrestricted probabilities allowed
one t in the fixed public pair at u0=k/N witnessing both conditional and average lower bounds
